title: [Subcontracting] Added assisted setup guide for initial app configuration
summary: Subcontracting app now includes a three-step assisted setup wizard that guides users through initial configuration independently, without requiring Manufacturing Setup during installation.
key_points: New three-step Subcontracting Setup Wizard page for the initial app configuration
Users can review company defaults and open the remaining configuration pages without going through Manufacturing Setup
Guide hooked in through the Subcontracting business setup codeunit; permission set updated for the new page
Manufacturing Setup stays available through Manual Setup for later maintenance
UI tests added for the guide
quote: The guide lets users review company defaults and navigate to the remaining configuration pages without relying on Manufacturing Setup during the installation session.
